m.summary:
The bug was in the `checkout` loop in `src/checkout.ts`. When `reserve(sku, qty)` returned false, the code hit `continue` and silently skipped the sku. The doc comment says it should throw `'out of stock <sku>'`.

I changed line 6 to:
```ts
if (!reserve(sku, qty)) { throw new Error(`out of stock ${sku}`); }
```
